scenes.text: Would you pay twenty five hundred dollars for a kilo of coffee that passed through an elephant?
It's called Black Ivory, made in Thailand from coffee cherries that elephants eat.
It takes about thirty five kilos of cherries to make one kilo of beans.
It's listed at twenty five hundred a kilo, nearly double civet coffee, kopi luwak, at thirteen hundred.
Pick one: elephant coffee, or your regular cup? Comment below.
